name: Browser Automation
instructions: Local headless Chrome for this machine on one persistent profile, so logins survive a close. Open a session, then run short scripts (goto, snapshot, click, fill, shot). The Browser tab in the right sidebar shows the session live; a click or keystroke there reaches the same page a script drives. Sessions are tabs owned by the thread that opened them and expire after 30 minutes, or after 5 idle minutes. First open installs playwright-core into the plugin's data folder.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a local headless Chrome session for this thread. The right-sidebar Browser tab shows it live.

tools.name: browser_run
tools.description: Run a trusted browser script in an open session. Use const p = await browser.getPage("main"), then p.goto, p.snapshot, p.click, p.fill, p.shot. Runs in one session are serialized.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a JPEG of the main page in a session and return its path.

tools.name: browser_pages
tools.description: List the pages in a session, with their names, URLs and titles.

tools.name: browser_list
tools.description: List browser sessions for this thread, newest state first.

tools.name: browser_stop
tools.description: Stop Chrome for a session, keeping its record and profile.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close a session, stop Chrome and remove its profile and captures.
